A split scene contrasting two realities based on James 5. On the left side, an arrogant, wealthy man in fine robes counts a pile of gold coins that are visibly tarnishing and rusting, completely ignoring a tired, impoverished farmer holding a sickle who is begging for his wages. Above the rich man, dark storm clouds gather to symbolise impending judgment. On the right side, a simple scale of justice tips heavily, showing the phrase "Cries of the Reapers" outweighing "Corrupt Wealth".
